However, the proposed remedy focuses mainly on a nationally governed information model and gives less attention to implementation guides, terminology versions, workflow agreements, and conformance testing.

public.text: The warning that use of the same standard can create “interoperable silos” is important. However, the proposed remedy focuses mainly on a nationally governed information model and gives less attention to implementation guides, terminology versions, workflow agreements, and conformance testing.
public.suggestedRevision: State that semantic interoperability requires coordinated national models, profiles, extensions, terminology bindings, workflow specifications, version policies, and conformance testing.
